defs.def: to make the sounds and movements of your face that show you are happy or think sth is funny 笑；发笑

ex.s: Friends laughed a little, and even Mark’s parents thought he should just give up.
ex.t: 我正准备离开时，那只蜂鸟出现了。

ex.s: “I am ahead of my time.” If he seems a little defensive, it might be because even some of his coworkers occasionally laugh at his unusual methods.
ex.t: “我走在了时代前面。”如果他听起来有点自我辩解，那可能是因为连他的一些同事偶尔也会嘲笑他不同寻常的方法。

ex.s: But Farber is certain he’ll have the last laugh.
ex.t: 但法伯确信笑到最后的会是他。

ex.s: No one laughed harder than he did.
ex.t: 没有人比他笑得更厉害。

ex.s: When I handed in the essay to my teacher, he read it, laughed out loud, and said, “Great.
ex.t: 当我把文章交给老师时，他读了之后放声大笑，说：“很好。

ex.s: No one laughed harder than he did.

ex.s: Trembling, they were yet laughing and hugging each other.
ex.t: 他们颤抖着，却笑着互相拥抱。

ex.s: We laughed together, often, but from the stories we’ve shared about ourselves, I know I’m not the only one who faces life’s challenges.
ex.t: 我们经常一起大笑，但从我们分享的故事中，我知道我不是唯一一个面对人生挑战的人。

ex.s: I half expected a____7____— at least an “I hope you’ve learned your lesson”. ____8____, mum laughed and laughed as she read.
ex.t: 我本以为会得到一个____7____——至少是一句"我希望你吸取了教训"。____8____，妈妈读着读着笑个不停。

ex.s: The next day, when Ms Black read the essay to the class, everyone laughed.
ex.t: 第二天，当布莱克女士在班上朗读这篇文章时，大家都笑了。

ex.s: “I was afraid that kids from other schools would laugh at him,” he explained uncomfortably.
ex.t: "我怕其他学校的孩子会嘲笑他，"他不自在地解释道。

ex.s: “My husband is the worst page turner,” she laughed.
ex.t: "我丈夫是最糟糕的翻谱员，"她笑着说。

ex.s: If you can start the conversation with a question other than “What do you do for a living?", you'll be able to get a lot more interesting conversation out of whomever it is you're talking to. ____37 ___. it can bring in "I have this old, broken-down vehicle" or "I rode the bus with these crazy people who were laughing at silly jokes in the back." It just opens up conversation.
ex.t: 如果你能以一个“你做什么工作”之外的问题开启对话……

ex.s: He who laughs last laughs longest
ex.t: 谁笑到最后，谁笑得最久。

ex.s: 63  (choose), but when he presented his masterpiece to the emperor’s chief minister, the old nan laughed.
ex.t: 63  （选择），但当他把他的杰作呈给皇帝的首席大臣时，这位老人笑了。

ex.s: Humor lets you better understand life and sometimes helps you laugh at even the worst of your problems.
ex.t: 幽默让你更好地理解生活，有时甚至能让你对最糟糕的问题一笑置之。

ex.s: You have to be at least a bit self-assured to laugh at yourself in front of others.
ex.t: 你至少需要一点自信才能在别人面前嘲笑自己。

ex.s: The family hugged and smiled through misty eyes and then laughed.
ex.t: 一家人含泪微笑着拥抱，然后笑了起来。

ex.s: He wore his socks too high, listened to __20__ country music and laughed too loudly in front of my friends.
ex.t: 他的袜子穿得太高，听__20__乡村音乐，在朋友面前笑得太大声。

ex.s: "During a time of stress for families, it's nice to be able to help them smile and laugh," Parry said.
ex.t: "在家庭压力较大的时期，能够帮助他们微笑和欢笑是一件美好的事，"帕里说。

ex.s: I would have laughed heartily.
ex.t: 我会大笑不止。

ex.s: With 5_______, he began, but everyone laughed.
ex.t: 他开始讲话，但大家都笑了。

ex.s: This time, both of us laughed.
ex.t: 这一次，我们俩都笑了。

ex.s: In fact, we ended up laughing and ate them all.
ex.t: 事实上，我们最后笑着把它们都吃完了。

ex.s: We toasted each other, we laughed, and the simple, homemade dishes tasted more delicious than anything cooked by a top chef.
ex.t: 我们互相敬酒、欢笑，简单自制的菜肴比任何顶级厨师做的都更美味。

ex.s: One moment she seems to be laughing at me, but then again I catch a sense of sadness in her smile.
ex.t: 有一刻她好像在嘲笑我，但随后我又从她的微笑中捕捉到一丝悲伤。

ex.s: Ms Donohue used to be laughed at for being too old to work out, but she has proved the ___54___ wrong in the best possible way and has indeed become an ___55___ for many social media users.
ex.t: 多诺休女士过去常因年纪太大不能锻炼而被嘲笑，但她……

defs.def: the sound you make when you are amused or happy 笑声
an enjoyable and amusing occasion or thing that happens 令人开心的时刻；引人发笑的事；笑料
a person who is amusing and fun to be with 引人发笑的人；逗笑好玩的人

ex.s: I could ____9____ they weren’t making fun of me: they laughed because I had the power to tell a funny story.
ex.t: 我能____9____他们不是在嘲笑我：他们笑是因为我有能力讲一个有趣的故事。
